svg.aria-label: One line of C, growing a lane per level
svg.title: One line of C, growing a lane per level
svg.desc: Three lines from a nine line C file each grow a lane at a time as they go down the pipeline, from GENERIC to GIMPLE to RTL to the assembly. The assignment on line 5 keeps roughly the same amount of work at every level. The loop header on line 6 is one line of C and picks up six pieces of RTL and six instructions. The return on line 8 has something at GENERIC and something at GIMPLE and then two empty lanes, because by the time the compiler is choosing instructions the value is already sitting in the register the function returns in.

g.text: 5 GENERIC for `for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)`.
4 GIMPLE for `for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)`.
6 RTL for `for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)`.
6 assembly for `for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)`.
Nothing at RTL. The line has run out of pipeline to go down.
Nothing at assembly. The line has run out of pipeline to go down.
